docs: The token mint that was deposited

fields.name: total_amount_deposited

fields.name: last_deposit_time

Useful for analytics and time-based features

fields.name: depositor_bump

types.name: GlobalConfig

docs: Platform fee percentage in basis points (0.01% increments)
Allows flexible fee adjustment without code modifications

fields.name: admin
docs: The authority that can update this config and manage the platform

fields.name: max_retries
docs: Maximum number of transaction retry attempts
Provides configurable resilience for trade execution

fields.name: min_profit_threshold
docs: Minimum profit threshold for executing trades
Prevents executing trades with negligible returns

fields.name: global_config_bump
docs: This account's bump seed for verification

types.name: InitializeEvent

Records the initial configuration parameters

fields.name: admin
docs: The admin who initialized the platform

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: The initial fee percentage in basis points

fields.name: min_profit_threshold
docs: The initial minimum profit threshold

fields.name: max_retries
docs: The initial maximum retry count

types.name: StrategyCreatedEvent
docs: Event emitted when a new strategy is created
Records the strategy parameters and creation time

fields.name: strategy_vault
docs: The public key of the created strategy vault

fields.name: deposit_token_mint
docs: The token mint used for this strategy

fields.name: risk_level
docs: The risk level of the strategy

fields.name: created_at
docs: Timestamp when the strategy was created

types.name: StrategyVault
docs: Strategy vault for managing trading capital and strategy parameters
Each vault represents a specific trading strategy with its own risk profile

fields.name: deposit_token_mint
docs: The token mint used for deposits in this strategy
Determines which token can be deposited and traded

fields.name: total_deposits
docs: Total amount of tokens deposited into this strategy
Tracks the total capital available for trading

fields.name: created_at
docs: Timestamp when the strategy was created
Useful for tracking strategy performance over time

fields.name: risk_level
docs: Risk level of the strategy (higher = more aggressive)
Determines trading parameters and risk tolerance

fields.name: is_active
docs: Whether the strategy is currently active
Inactive strategies cannot accept new deposits

fields.name: is_delegated
docs: Whether the strategy is currently delegated to a trading bot
Prevents withdrawals during active trading sessions

fields.name: total_profit
docs: Total profit earned by the strategy
Tracks the total profit generated by the strategy

fields.name: strategy_vault_bump
docs: This account's bump seed for PDA verification

types.name: TreasuryVault
docs: Treasury vault for managing platform profits and distributions

fields.name: treasury_admin
docs: The admin public key authorized to manage treasury operations
Controls profit distribution and treasury management

fields.name: total_profits_secured
docs: Total amount of profits secured by the platform
Tracks all profits ever generated across all strategies

fields.name: total_profits_distributed
docs: Total amount of profits distributed to stakeholders
Tracks how much profit has been paid out

fields.name: last_distribution_time
docs: Timestamp of the last profit distribution
Used to schedule regular distributions

fields.name: treasury_vault_bump
docs: This account's bump seed for PDA verification
